content: Kiara Sen asked Vikram Patel how to renew her health policy that expired on December 10, 2026. Vikram apologized for the inconvenience, attached a renewal form, and instructed her to complete and return it by December 20, 2026, offering further assistance if needed.

action_items: Kiara to fill out and return the attached renewal form by 2026-12-20
Kiara to contact Vikram if she has any questions or needs assistance
